message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now strips accents from the title before it reaches the vendored `slugify`. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the vendored `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. I didn't touch them because you only asked about blog posts. The same accent-stripping step would fix them if you want it.
